activity: Wi-Fi lifecycle reliability audit
notes: Fixed: external reconnect() could reset retry budget and bypass provisioning/AP fallback; NTP sync missing on actual CONNECTED transition path; m_connecting could remain true; re-provisioning while connected could fail because stale STA pre-empted WAITING_TO_CONNECT. Fixes: hardened reconnect() state guards; centralized handleConnected(); NTP sync on every connection transition; provisioning guards prevent stale events interrupting reprovisioning; provisioning flag reset on disconnect. State machine: DISCONNECTED/CONNECTING/CONNECTED/ACCESS_POINT/WAITING_TO_CONNECT/ERROR. Security: AP password resolution centralized; no Wi-Fi password logging.
